mapper.select: SELECT e.name, d.seniority_no, s.base_date AS latest_base_date, s.cycle_day AS latest_cycle_day FROM hd_driver d JOIN hd_employee e ON e.name = d.employee_name LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ds.base_date, ds.cycle_day FROM hd_duty_start ds WHERE ds.employee_name = e.name ORDER BY ds.base_date DESC, ds.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) s ON true WHERE d.seniority_no IS NOT NULL AND e.retired_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.seniority_no
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO hd_duty_start (employee_name, base_date, cycle_day, created_by) VALUES
(#{item.employeeName}, #{baseDate}, #{item.cycleDay}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE hd_duty_start SET employee_name = #{newName} WHERE employee_name = #{oldName}
UPDATE hd_duty_override SET employee_name = #{newName} WHERE employee_name = #{oldName}
UPDATE hd_duty_override_log SET employee_name = #{newName} WHERE employee_name = #{oldName}
